items.title: Define versioned impact classification and fail-closed eligibility
items.context: Compute stable reason codes from signed prior-pass bindings, semantic and render digests, freshness-reader output, scope and policy state, rename-aware changed files, and supported bounded categories. Unknown, public-contract, authority, policy, dynamic-reference, or parse-failure cases select full.

happy.desc: A current signed prior pass for the same reviewer lane with complete material, storyFiles, scope, policy, Runtime, Role, environment, assembler, launcher, and command bindings plus a trusted allowed freshness class and complete impact closure is mechanically classified incremental with a deterministic digest and stable reason codes.

A pure test-fixture delta selects incremental only when every changed path has an explicit checklist files.test declaration and every changed case has a current Story-scoped intentRef; output records exact changed and impacted file digests.
Metadata-only HEAD drift selects incremental only when the canonical freshness reader classifies it as an explicitly allowed known class; eligibility does not reinterpret raw hashes.

edge.desc: Public API, schema, protocol, authority, permission, command policy, gate semantics, dependency, build entry, docs-only, private implementation, review policy, required-lane, scope, Runtime, Role, or agent-facing render changes select full with stable reason codes in v1.

Missing or stale prior-pass data, wrong-lane pass, incomplete bindings, changed-files failure, dynamic reference, unknown language, parse failure, untrusted lineage, unknown environment or tool state, or unproven impact closure selects full.
A rename, deletion, cross-file change, or fixture change without complete declared intent closure falls back to full; no unsupported category is inferred incremental.

adversarial.desc: Caller-supplied contextMode, forceIncremental, fabricated reason codes, reviewer notes, or main-agent arguments cannot override the mechanical result; identical authoritative inputs yield identical output.
Crafted raw hashes cannot impersonate metadata-only drift, and empty or no-signal storyFilesHash cannot qualify stale material for incremental review.
Policy rules are consumed from one registered versioned contract and verifier; tests fail for unregistered heuristics or a policy-version change that leaves the eligibility digest unchanged.

items.userSees: Terminal output includes quoted fields contextMode=incremental or contextMode=full, impactPolicyVersion, freshnessClassification, and eligibilityReasonCodes; unknown inputs show contextMode=full.

verificationEvidence.note: Policy smoke proves only trusted eligibility paths are accepted and legacy unsigned runs fail closed.
Pure fixture classification requires files.test declaration plus a nonempty Story intentRef binding.
CLI-shaped smoke transcript shows canonical metadata-only and related-story freshness classes, with no raw-hash reinterpretation.
Table-driven forced-full cases cover docs, public contract, authority, command/gate, dependency/build and private implementation.
Unknown paths and untrusted legacy PASS/ReviewRun input select full with stable codes.
Rename-aware old/new paths are retained and R status selects FULL_UNSUPPORTED_RENAME.
Executable advisory path exposes no caller force/contextMode input and deterministically emits authoritative full fallback for untrusted evidence.
Canonical freshness reader, signed run verification, envelope integrity and no-signal handling precede eligibility.
Process-fact verifier proves the versioned impact/freshness eligibility fact is registered as one L4 gate contract.

items.title: Assemble bounded reviewBasis and choose the safe context mode
items.context: Construct the incremental delta from current authoritative references, impacted verification intent, findings, invariants, and affected contracts; compare final sizes only after safety eligibility and choose full with FULL_CHEAPER_OR_EQUAL when incremental is not cheaper.
items.userSees: Terminal output includes reviewBasis, changedFiles, impactedFiles, and either selectionReason=SAFE_INCREMENTAL or selectionReason=FULL_CHEAPER_OR_EQUAL after safety eligibility.

happy.desc: Eligible incremental context contains compact Runtime and complete Role contracts, prior pass and hash bindings, changed and impacted files, finding deltas, scope acknowledgement, impacted intents, re-review reason, current claims, invariants, unresolved findings, affected contracts, and authoritative references.
Safety eligibility is decided before cost comparison; when both modes are safe and final incremental is smaller than full, incremental is selected and both measured sizes and digests are auditable.
Incremental assembly preserves repository-relative current authoritative references and the reviewer contract permits reading them on demand rather than treating omitted injection as a prohibition.

edge.desc: When final incremental size is equal to or larger than final full size, full is selected with FULL_CHEAPER_OR_EQUAL without rewriting the prior safety decision.
Added, resolved, and dismissed findings plus impacted intents retain stable identities and current states; unrelated material is omitted only when closure proves it outside the basis.
A reasoned reviewer request for missing or non-closed context produces a full-context run rather than silently expanding an incremental payload under the same identity.

adversarial.desc: Stale prior prose, historical contracts, caller-authored file lists, or references outside the trusted current workspace cannot replace authoritative sources or produce a valid reviewBasis digest.
Omitting an affected contract, open finding, impacted intent, invariant dependency, or changed fixture makes completeness unverifiable and selects full.
A tiny attacker-crafted incremental payload cannot win when eligibility requires full, and an oversized full payload cannot cause incremental fallback to evade correctness.

verificationEvidence.note: Bounded basis schema and assembly cover current claims, invariants, findings, impacted intents/contracts, scope and authoritative refs.
Conditional assembly proves safety precedes final byte comparison and SAFE_INCREMENTAL only wins when smaller.
Executable prompt smoke preserves repository-relative authoritativeReferences inside the bound basis.
Oversized bounded basis selects full with exact FULL_CHEAPER_OR_EQUAL reason after safety succeeds.
Versioned basis validator retains stable finding and intent identity/state fields.
Reviewer escalation case mints full mode with REVIEWER_REQUESTED_FULL and a recorded reason.
Basis is constructed from trusted current store/git facts and exact schema rejects caller-authored unknown fields.
Missing basis on otherwise eligible conditional assembly selects SAFETY_REQUIRES_FULL.
Public-contract forced full remains full even under budget pressure; full budget violation cannot select incremental.

items.title: Bind incremental envelopes to ReviewRun and pass gates
items.context: Persist auditable context-mode fields and require a valid current envelope binding so an incorrectly served incremental context cannot produce an admissible pass, receipt, or quorum contribution. Callers cannot override the mechanical decision.
items.userSees: A valid run prints Prompt Envelope <id> bound to ReviewRun <id>; a mismatch prints an explicit incremental envelope binding rejection and awards no REVIEW or quorum credit.

happy.desc: A trusted incremental Prompt Envelope records all context, prior-pass, contract, environment, policy, eligibility, freshness, file, reviewBasis, escalation, and digest fields and binds them to exact Story, HEAD, round, lane, and signed ReviewRun.
A pass from a valid current incremental envelope is accepted only after shared binding and digest re-verification; REVIEW, receipt, readiness, and quorum consume that same admissibility result.
Mechanical or reviewer-requested escalation records its reason and binds the full envelope to the run so the obsolete incremental envelope cannot authorize the final pass.

edge.desc: A pre-migration pass without Prompt Envelope fields remains legacy-full-context in its original round and cannot become an incremental prior pass through default values.
Existing kind-aware material and scope freshness semantics remain intact; older open findings stay visible and empty storyFilesHash supplies no advisory signal.
Missing, unknown-version, malformed, or inconsistent incremental fields are rejected at envelope verification and cannot be repaired downstream.

adversarial.desc: Single-field tampering across envelope, prior pass, Story, HEAD, lane, round, run, material, storyFiles, scope, policy, freshness, contracts, files, basis, or context digests invalidates the pass and downstream credit.
If incremental context was served when authoritative eligibility required full, a syntactically valid reviewer response cannot mint an admissible pass, receipt, host verdict, or quorum contribution.
Main, implementer, compatibility aliases, request payloads, cached sidecars, or caller objects cannot supply authoritative envelope fields, override mode, or bypass trusted assembly.

verificationEvidence.note: Second same-material reviewer runs persist signed SAFE_INCREMENTAL envelopes bound to exact run/lane/round/hashes and pass verification.
39-check executable quorum transcript proves REVIEW and quorum consume shared envelope admissibility, including incremental runs.
Reviewer-requested and mechanical escalation produce full envelopes with new bound identity and explicit reason.
Unsigned or envelope-less legacy pass/run input cannot establish an incremental baseline and selects full.
Stale older pass-envelope issues are superseded only when the same lane has newer valid evidence; stale material and findings remain enforced.
Exact PromptEnvelope schema requires total incremental policy, freshness, files, basis, task-semantic and selection fields.
Replay/tamper tests prove mutated envelopes invalidate machine REVIEW and quorum through the shared verifier.
Gate recomputes authoritative eligibility and rejects incremental mode whenever recomputation requires full; no pass/quorum credit survives.
Strict schema and trusted review_run_start assembly reject caller-controlled unknown envelope fields and cross-role substitution.

items.title: Prove read-only compatibility, escalation safety, and budget behavior
items.context: Keep review_incremental_context itself advisory and gate-neutral; cover supported bounded changes, forced-full classes, stale and untrusted evidence, reviewer full-context requests, FULL_CHEAPER_OR_EQUAL, and budget violations separated from correctness decisions.
items.userSees: Repeated review_incremental_context output is deterministic and read-only; full escalation prints escalationReason, and an oversized correctness-required full prompt prints budgetViolation without changing contextMode=full.

happy.desc: Calling review_incremental_context changes no files, process events, Story metadata, review evidence, phases, guards, receipts, floor, quorum, or DONE outcome; it remains advisory until trusted assembly consumes the result.
An incremental reviewer can read referenced current authoritative material and request full context with a recorded reason without accepting an incomplete basis.
Measurement records incremental and full sizes plus budget status while eligibility and escalation remain correctness decisions and violations stay separately auditable.

edge.desc: An incremental context exceeding its budget escalates to full without truncating required evidence or authorizing an incremental pass.

When safety requires full but full exceeds ordinary budget, correct full context remains available, the violation is recorded, and baseline or enforce convergence is blocked without incremental fallback.
When incremental is equal or larger, full is selected with FULL_CHEAPER_OR_EQUAL and repeated advisory calls remain deterministic and gate-neutral.

adversarial.desc: Manipulated estimator metadata, caller sizes, omitted sections, compression claims, or budget values cannot override safety, erase a violation, or convert required full into incremental.
Arguments cannot write passes, findings, scope acknowledgements, envelopes, receipts, host verdicts, quorum, or transitions; repeated and concurrent calls do not alter gates.

A campaign proves stale or untrusted evidence, public contracts, docs, private implementation, policy, authority, command, dynamic, parse-failure, and unknown-impact cases always select full while only proven bounded cases select incremental.
